solutions.title: Exhaustive permutations
solutions.strategy: Try every ordering and keep the lexicographically largest concatenation.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every permutation is materialized and compared, with d total digits.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion path and candidate string are stored.

solutions.title: Concatenation sort
solutions.strategy: Sort string values by which concatenation order produces a larger pairwise result.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting performs comparator calls that compare concatenations of digit strings.

spaceComplexity.explanation: String copies and the final concatenation are stored.
